notes_en:
🧪 Experimental build 18.8.7 (rc7+rc8)

✨ AmneziaWG — new protocol:
• AmneziaWG .conf files (obfuscation params Jc/Jmin/Jmax/S1-S2/H1-H4) import and connect directly
• Standalone AmneziaWG v3.1 core (userspace, gvisor netstack) — Android, Windows, macOS, Linux
• Plain WireGuard configs keep working on the existing path

🧹 Server list cleanup:
• Remove slow (over 1500 ms) and dead servers from the servers menu
• «Fast» filter chip in the server list
• «Keep only the fastest of each subscription» option — slow servers pruned after each update, pinned ones kept

💡 Smart suggestion:
• After several failed connections in a row, the app suggests built-in Cloudflare WARP (no server needed)
